5: MÍTRITCH. It's a fine mess. But there's the Foundlings' [6] for that sort of thing. Whoever likes may drop one there; they'll take 'em all. Give 'em as many as you like, they ask no questions, and even pay—if the mother goes in as a wet-nurse. It's easy enough nowadays.
3: NIKÍTA. Yes, they're off! But things are not right! I don't know what to do!
2: MÍTRITCH. All right, you throw it to the sheep. Well, have you seen 'em all off?
1: NIKÍTA. Mítritch, you get off to sleep and I'll put this straight.
